text:
evan: Quick planning thread — want to try a profile-driven nurture that adapts content blocks based on progressive signals (read depth, demo click, company size). main goal: reduce churn in the waitlist and drive webinar signups and trial starts.

sasha: love the idea. core segments we should derive on-send: `behavioral_read` (pages viewed), `demo_click` (clicked pricing/demo), `company_tier` (SMB/Enterprise). we'll need dynamic content blocks in Braze for: technical snippet, ROI bullets, and enterprise calendar.

devin: +1. can we map rules like: if demo_click == true show code snippet block; else show quick case study. and if company_tier == Enterprise show calendar CTA, else show public webinar CTA.

leo: yes — that's straightforward. i'll implement Liquid logic in the template:

```liquid
{% if recipient.demo_click %}
  <!-- show code block -->
{% elsif recipient.company_tier == 'Enterprise' %}
  <!-- enterprise CTA -->
{% else %}
  <!-- webinar CTA -->
{% endif %}
```

sasha: subject testing plan: two variants per message — technical (code-forward) vs narrative (customer-first). run test only on a 20% holdback of `demo_click` segment first. measure opens/clicks over 12h.

evan: cadence: Email A (day 0) welcome + dynamic first block, Email B (day 3) short benchmark + either curl snippet or customer quote depending on segment, Email C (day 9) webinar invite or enterprise book-a-demo. keep copy <=120 words and single primary CTA.

leo: include a tiny inline curl for technical block:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","prompt":"hello"}'
```

devin: tracking & UTMs: utm_campaign=profile_nurture_q3, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. events: open, click, demo_click, webinar_reg, trial_start. create cohort profile_nurture_q3_{segment} for funnel analysis.

sasha: suppression rules: exclude any unsubscribed/bounced in last 90 days, internal domains, attendees of the last similar webinar (tagged `bench_jun`). and exclude anyone with trial_start already.

evan: rollouts: phase 1 = demo_click (n ~ 3.8k) next Tue 9am PT. send Email A -> wait 24h. gating: if open < 13% swap subject variant and resend to non-openers. if click >= 4% proceed to full expansion on Thu.

leo: creative constraints: images must be <100KB; animated GIFs discouraged unless under 80KB. provide PNG chart for benchmark block sized 600x120 and compressed. always include alt text and plain-text fallback.

devin: segmentation CSV columns: email,segment,company,company_size,intent_score,behavioral_read,signup_ts,exclude_flag. i'll drop to #marketing-assets by tomorrow 9am.

sasha: owners: devin = segment exports + suppressions, leo = template + dynamic blocks, me = subject tests + creative QA, evan = copy + measurement. i'll coordinate with growth for progressive profiling hooks.

marketing-bot: reminder set: draft templates due Fri EOD; dry-run send scheduled Mon to internal list. :spiral_calendar_pad:

evan: one more — for enterprise leads with intent_score > 85 surface a short 1-click trial start link in the email (deep link) and tag as `high_intent_enterprise`. ensure legal/ops signoff for that flow.

leo: noted — will add `if recipient.intent_score > 85 and recipient.company_tier == 'Enterprise'` branch. will keep the deep link: https://cal.redwood.ai/enterprise?utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=profile_nurture_q3

devin: analytics: please ensure demo_click is captured as a custom event before send so dynamic blocks render correctly. i'll coordinate with engineering to backfill if needed.

sasha: sounds good. next checkpoint here after template draft and CSV drop. thanks everyone! :rocket:
